title: Innovation Lineage Attestation — Convergence Certification Auditor
description: World-first constitutionally-governed V10 convergence certification system. CCA evaluates the full GIR→CGR→CPE→CAL loop against eight frozen V10 criteria (weights sum to 1.0), computes a weighted Convergence Score (0.0–1.0), issues HMAC-SHA-256-sealed Convergence Certificates when score ≥ 0.875, emits HUMAN-0 ratification advisory before V10 Certificate issuance (CCA-HUMAN0-0), maintains an append-only HMAC-chained certification ledger (CCA-CHAIN-0 / CCA-IMMUT-0), and emits structured outcome telemetry for CAL learning loop closure. CCA is the final constitutional gate before ADAAD v10.0.0 graduation.
world_first_description: First constitutionally-governed autonomous V10 convergence certification system with cryptographically sealed, HMAC-chained Convergence Certificates and HUMAN-0 advisory emission for autonomous graduation gate control.

Criterion 4: Constitutional Stability — CCA certifies the invariant density required for V10
Criterion 5: CEL Loop Closure — CCA enforces CEL loop closure as a non-waivable V10 prerequisite
Criterion 7: Self-Authorship — CCA is itself an autonomous certification agent within the governed pipeline
